entries.summary: Adds the complete cell-owned three-file basics set: a first-reader guide for vertical datums, ground and water elevations, component critical points and local depth; a seven-stage evidence-to-SHIP explanation; and an exact model reference with curves, fields, value linkage, capability limits, sources, validation status, and worked damage/loss assembly. Establishes the reusable per-cell basics pattern without changing the model.
entries.consumer_action: No runtime action. Continue to pin model v1.0/docs r4/bundle v2 and its recorded SHA. Treat all basics examples as illustrative unless site evidence supplies the actual geometry, value, and exposure inputs.
